integrity: The analytic proof gives universal uniqueness and comparative statics; numerical diagnostics are not an infinite proof. Available full primary literature was compared; one highly relevant source remained abstract-only. Historical priority is provisional.
scientific_limitations: Local Fisher D-optimal design for independent homogeneous Poisson objects under exact half-normal detection, fully observed detection distances, linear per-width cost and a nominal unknown scale; not general ecological field validation, finite-sample density-only optimization or independence certification.
title: Unique D-optimal truncation width for a half-normal line transect with width-dependent survey cost
